title: Slip Coding.pdf — page 37
text:
4. Enter the special 
condition details
• In Condition Name, give your 
condition a meaningful name.
• Enter Total Limit (if you are 
applying a sublimit).
• Enter Deductible (monetary or 
percentage).
• If you are applying a % 
deductible per location, enter the 
percentage here.
• The second table in the window 
is used to define which locations 
the rule will apply to.
